categories.main_business_segments: Yizumi Holdings Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the mold forming equipment industry, focusing on the design, R&D, production, sales, and service of injection molding machines, die casting machines, and rubber injection machines. The company serves diverse sectors including automotive, 3C electronics, home appliances, packaging, medical, and light industry. It also engages in global operations with subsidiaries in regions such as North America, India, Mexico, Turkey, and Thailand.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes advanced manufacturing technologies including Industrial 4.0 smart manufacturing, servo-driven hydraulic systems, intelligent control systems with remote monitoring and digital twin technology, and high-speed molding processes. Key products include the A6 high-end intelligent injection molding machine series and NEXT2 two-plate die casting machines, featuring innovations in energy efficiency, precision, and automation. Yizumi also develops multi-material molding and semi-solid magnesium alloy injection molding technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Yizumi serves major customers in the automotive, 3C electronics, home appliance, packaging, medical, and light industrial sectors. Its products are used globally, with significant market penetration in China and expanding presence in Southeast Asia, North America, Europe, and emerging markets like India. The company collaborates with leading automotive parts manufacturers and electronics companies, supporting industries such as new energy vehicles and consumer electronics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China with major production bases in Guangdong (Shunde High-tech Zone, Wusha Industrial Park), Suzhou, and Zhejiang (Nantong). Internationally, it has subsidiaries and production facilities in the United States (Ohio), India (Gujarat), Mexico, Turkey, and Thailand. Its overseas business covers over 90 countries and regions, with tailored local operations and marketing strategies.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yizumi operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of high-end molding equipment. It integrates upstream R&D and production with downstream sales and after-sales services, positioning itself as a comprehensive equipment solutions provider in the polymer and metal forming industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation with a focus on intelligent digitalization, global expansion, and green development. R&D efforts concentrate on smart manufacturing, energy-efficient and precision equipment, and new materials processing technologies. Yizumi invests heavily in its R&D team, maintaining a three-tier innovation system and leveraging global innovation platforms to develop differentiated products and enhance customer value.
categories.revenue_model: Yizumi generates revenue mainly through the sales of injection molding machines, die casting machines, rubber injection machines, and related products. It employs a direct sales model domestically and a combination of direct and distributor sales internationally. Revenue is recognized primarily at the point of product delivery and customer acceptance, with additional income from after-sales services and financing leasing operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yizumi is one of the leading equipment manufacturers in China’s molding machinery industry, ranking second in comprehensive strength among Chinese plastic machinery manufacturers and second in the injection molding machine sector. It competes with both domestic and international brands by focusing on high-end, intelligent, and green equipment solutions. Its LEAP series die casting machines and A6 injection molding machines have established strong market competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Yizumi achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 5.06 billion, representing a 23.61% year-over-year increase, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 607.9 million, up 27.42%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 7.11 billion, with a net asset value of RMB 2.96 billion. It maintains a robust growth trajectory supported by expanding production capacity, global market penetration, and continuous R&D investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yizumi emphasizes differentiated product competitiveness through technological innovation, focusing on intelligent, precise, green, and efficient manufacturing solutions. Its products incorporate advanced servo systems, intelligent control, and digital twin technologies to enhance production efficiency and quality. The company’s global service network and commitment to quality management provide superior customer value, supporting clients in high-growth sectors like new energy vehicles and precision electronics.
